name: Startup to rated speed
description: Cold start from rest: crank, purge, light-off, accelerate, starter cut-out, governor takes over at rated speed (breaker open, no load).

criteria.text: Speed reaches 3500 +/- 50 RPM within 60 s and holds for 10 s
Speed never exceeds the 3850 RPM overspeed trip level
Exhaust gas temperature stays below the 620 degC trip level

negative_tests.text: With the speed governor removed the start-up fuel ramp keeps accelerating the rotor past rated speed and the overspeed protection has to trip it.
